items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: I did something with Mark Cohen, Fats Domino, Dave, DeVell, Johnny Adams, I'm a Thomas. Well, I didn't do no. I just do a head, a band arrangement, stage arrangement.

ctx.x: Who have you been working with lately? I haven't.

Well, you heard about the Bobby Robinson thing. I did an album with them. It was this Bobby Robinson. They did it in New Orleans too. It was like a Mardi Gras type stuff, the album is. We did a video. I was on the video at the Margarita. I did something with Mark Cohen, Fats Domino, Dave, DeVell, Johnny Adams, I'm a Thomas. Well, I didn't do no. I just do a head, a band arrangement, stage arrangement. I'm doing the Neville Brothers, really this week, starting this week.
For a new album they're working on? Yeah. It's the Neville Brothers, not Aaron? I think it's A&M.
